summary: Two hikers and a dog stranded overnight by deep snow on the McCurdy Park Trail; 10-hour hike-in reached them at 10pm, and a Colorado National Guard Blackhawk extracted all via hoist/LZ after a weather-aborted first attempt
location: McCurdy Park Trail, Lost Creek Wilderness
responding_agency: Park County SAR + Alpine Rescue Team, El Paso County SAR, Teller County SAR, Lake George Fire, Ute Pass Ambulance, CO National Guard Blackhawk
notes: approx; satellite SOS March 15 2023, reached 10:03pm March 16; early frostbite; extracted 4:53pm
